I have some schooling, but on this small plot I still do what I have seen work around me and what my household can pay for. This plot is only 0.14 hectare, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer just for it because cash is tight and the small area does not justify a full purchase unless we share a bag, and this season I will keep that money for the bigger plots. Since the land is ours, I will put manure or compost there, use local seed I can trust, and rely on family work instead of hiring people.
